title: CPL supplemental primary-source and reuse-rights register

records.finding: CDC warns risk and protective factors are multifactorial; a factor is not a deterministic individual prediction.
records.limitations: Does not validate a CPL clinical risk algorithm or specific 911 decision threshold.
records.rightsStatus: See CDC rights policy; not reviewed for any incorporated artwork.

records.sourceDateMeaning: guideline edition, not last webpage review
records.finding: VA/DoD 2023 CPG supports PE, CPT and EMDR as individual trauma-focused psychotherapy recommendations.
records.limitations: Needs population-specific and comorbidity-specific clinician review; source does not authorize copying third-party manuals.
records.rightsStatus: VA government-produced policy may be uncopyrighted; independently authored manuals require asset-level rights review.

records.owner: International OCD Foundation / Jon Abramowitz, PhD

records.owner: Barbara Stanley and Gregory K. Brown
records.sourceDateMeaning: PDF filename contains 05-02-2024; explicit copyright years 2008, 2021, not verified publishing date
records.finding: Author's PDF permits individual use of the form; written permission is required for changes to their form or using their form in an electronic medical record.
records.limitations: CPL sheets may be original separate tools; we have NOT established reproduction, adaptation, derivative status or infringement.
records.rightsStatus: Hard review gate if the Stanley–Brown form itself is modified or embedded in an EMR; no reuse authorization inferred.

records.sourceDateMeaning: page last-updated date not visibly verified
records.finding: CDC says most information is public domain but third-party/contractor content and images can be restricted; conditions include attribution, nonendorsement, and no substantive change to reused content.
records.limitations: These are specific to reusing agency material, not a blanket license for CPL or for contractor illustrations.
records.rightsStatus: Verify source-by-source attribution and actual reproduction before clearance; no CDC logos without express permission.

records.finding: Government-produced material on VA sites generally lacks US copyright protection, while US government can hold copyrights transferred to it.
records.limitations: Guideline manuals, publisher articles, scales not authored by VA staff and logos can have other rights.
records.rightsStatus: Do not treat all VA-hosted content as public domain.

records.sourceDateMeaning: VA webpage footer last-updated date, not measure publication year
records.finding: VA describes its staff-developed PCL-5 as in the public domain, intended for qualified professionals/researchers; Spanish version edited/confirmed but not validated in published research.
records.limitations: Permission and psychometric context must be checked per exact version; availability does not approve clinical use in all populations.
records.rightsStatus: PCL-5 itself described as public domain; record eligibility/translation caveats and distinguish other scales.

records.finding: VA describes its PC-PTSD-5 as public domain for qualified professionals/researchers; Spanish translation is edited/confirmed but not validated in published research.
records.limitations: Do not confuse screening with diagnosis or claim Spanish validation without study.
records.rightsStatus: Specific VA-created instrument only; do not extrapolate to non-VA measures.
